section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Riverside Pressure Registry.

Table 19. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |

| Younger adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Side effects | 189 | 750 |
